issues.jp_before: お母[かあ]さん、もう寝[ね]た{かな|kana-wonder}。
issues.problem: お母さん、 reads as a vocative (addressing Mom), clashing with the English; also a near-duplicate of the many もう〜たかな items.
issues.action: Rewrote as このシャツ、洗濯機{で|de-means}洗えるかな (washing-machine doubt).

issues.jp_before: あら、お客[きゃく]さん{は|wa-topic}もう帰[かえ]った{かしら/かな|kana-wonder}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 先生はもう帰ったかな (same verb and frame).
issues.action: Rewrote as あら、雨{が|ga-subject}止んだかしら/かな with English 'Oh, I wonder if the rain has stopped.'

issues.jp_before: 晩[ばん]ご飯[はん]{は|wa-topic}カレー{に|ni-change}しよう{かな|kana-wonder}。
issues.problem: English 'I think I'll have curry for dinner, maybe.' was clumsy and doubled the hedge.
issues.action: English changed to 'Maybe I'll have curry for dinner.'

issues.jp_before: 冷蔵庫[れいぞうこ]{に|ni-location}牛乳[ぎゅうにゅう]{が|ga-existence}まだある{かな|kana-wonder}。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot missing the equally natural は (牛乳はまだあるかな).

issues.jp_before: 薬[くすり]{を|o-object}飲[の]め{ば|ba-conditional}、頭痛[ずつう]{は|wa-topic}治[なお]る{かな|kana-wonder}。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot missing the equally natural が.

issues.jp_before: 荷物[にもつ]{は|wa-topic}もう届[とど]いた{かな|kana-wonder}。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot missing the equally natural が.

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]{は|wa-topic}どこ{に|ni-location}住[す]んでいる{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Humble 兄 means 'my brother', but the English asks about 'your brother'.
issues.action: Changed 兄[あに] to お兄[にい]さん.

issues.jp_before: ううん、まだ宿題[しゅくだい]{が|ga-subject}終[お]わっていない{の|no-final}。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot missing the equally natural は (宿題は終わっていない).

issues.jp_before: いい子[こ]だ{から|kara-because}、ちゃんと座[すわ]る{の|no-final}。
issues.problem: English 'good boy' adds a gender that いい子 does not carry.
issues.action: English changed to 'Be a good kid and sit properly.'
